title.english: Umm al-Hakam bint Abd al-Rahman ibn Mas'ud ibn Tha'laba ibn Asira ibn 'Asira ibn Atiyya ibn Judara al-Ansariyya; she is also called Umm Hakim.

segments.arabic:
١١٩٧٨- أم الحكم بنت عبد الرحمن
بن مسعود بن ثعلبة بن أسيرة بن عسيرة بن عطية بن جدارة الأنصاريّة، ويقال أم حكيم.
ذكرها ابن حبيب في المبايعات. وقال ابن سعد: تزوجها أبو مسعود عقبة «٤» بن عمرو البدريّ، وهي ممن أسلم وبايع النبي ﵌.
segments.english:
11978—Umm al-Hakam bint Abd al-Rahman ibn Mas'ud ibn Tha'laba ibn Asira ibn 'Asira ibn Atiyya ibn Judara al-Ansariyya; she is also called Umm Hakim.

Ibn Habib mentioned her among the women who pledged allegiance. Ibn Sa'd said: Abu Mas'ud Uqba (4) ibn Amr al-Badri married her. She was among the women who accepted Islam and pledged allegiance to the Prophet—may Allah bless him and grant him peace.
